reviews.comment: Professor Cartee was a pretty good lecturer, but the actual organization of the class was not the best. Exams and quizzes took over a month to be graded every time, so you never knew how you were doing in the class. Quizzes were never discussed in class and could be over anything the past few weeks. If possible, take with another prof
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Cartee is a good lecturer; he is just disorganized and strict with grading. If you want your final grade to be a surprise throughout the semester and not get your exam grades back until 4 weeks later, take him! He drops your lowest video quizzes, but doesn't drop anything or give extra credit unlike the entirety of the math department

Took a LONG time to grade all assignments. Did not give much homework; he seemed behind most weeks. Had excellent lectures and was very easy to understand. Adequately prepared students for tests: was committed to releasing multiple practice exams per test and lots of resources to study. If you do the work, the A is attainable.

Grading took a long time, which made it difficult to track my progress throughout the semester. While the professor was accessible outside of class, quizzes were only two questions and often unclear what they were over (could be what we just learned last class or over something from a few weeks ago). Overall, not the best experience.

I have not gotten an A in a single math class before this. "Easy" A but you NEED to go to EVERY CLASS and FOLLOW ALONG. He posts written notes and in class he goes at such an understandable pace and explains everything. Not many homeworks (limiting for practice), posted practice exams before exams that were very helpful and similar to actual tests.

Takes over a month to put each test grade in. Homework every week. Annoying when every other math 140 class has their test grades but you. Is available to talk to, but doesn't really know much about grades and when they're getting put in. Quizzes every Thursday. Knows math well, teaches it very slowly, but hw is way harder than in class examples.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He literally does not put grades in . I have my final next week and 2/3 of the homeworks and quizzes are not in canvas. There are quizzes every week but they are not hard. He is a lenient grader on exams and gives good partial credit.

Unfortunately took this as an 8am and there's iClicker questions on Tues and quizzes on Thurs. He's also part of the MLC so and was pretty helpful in answering questions. 140 is not a hard class to begin with, so I did reviews in the textbook + hands up grades up sessions to study for exams. He takes a while to grade things, but he's lowk the goat

I thought Prof Cartee was good. Takes a good amount of time to get grades back and put into canvas/gradebook. Homework and lecture videos each week. iclicker and quizzes in class during the week. Accessible outside of class through email and quick responses.
Good professor, but he takes a long time to grade. It was hard to know how I was doing in the class because we never had a real benchmark until late in the semester.

I struggled in this class, but it was definitely not because of Professor Cartee. He was a really good professor, fair grader, and willing to explain anything to you personally. My only complaint is he does take a very long time to grade. Overall though, I would recommend. He was everything a professor should be. Pop quizzes every week.

Dr. Cartee was a fabulous professor with amazing notes. Barely ever had to use sources outside of class to understand material but Edgar Haley's D.Eq course on Yt closely resembled Cartee's lessons. Since the class only has 2 tests and a final it's super important to do well on all tests but the practice tests help a tonne. Office hours help a lot!

Holy GOAT! Easily the best math professor I have ever had. I was scared about Diff EQ, but his lectures were slow, in-depth, very well explained, and practical. His notes are very helpful, homework is helpful and easy. The tests are tough, but he is a very generous grader. I appreciated his lectures a lot, if you show up to class, you will do well

If I had not put this class on the back burner, I would have gotten an A. His test reviews and worked out solutions help you study. HIs exams are hard but fair (308 is hard on its own). 100% would recommend, great prof!

This professor is VERY slow at grading. He did not post the final exam grades until one day after final grades were due, thus I could not request a bump. He also did not automatically bump me from an 89.8 to an A. Along with this the tests were vary long for a 50 minute exam time. Not many homework assignments, a lot of studying was on your own.

He is a very good professor to have. His canvas is the most organized I have ever seen. He makes himself very available outside of class and the exam questions were over stuff on exam reviews, examples in class, and homework. He is a little slow to grade assignments and homework sneaks up on you so be careful.

I actually love this man he is such an awesome professor and he makes complicated topics easier to understand. I usually have to self teach for math classes, but not for this one! His notes/lectures were enough. ATTEND LECTURES!! Class structured very well.

He's pretty nice, exams are similar to reviews, generous with partial credit and flexible with late homework. Homeworks were assigned with not much time before the due dates though and didn't post some of the homework keys until hours before the corresponding exam. Overall, a great choice.

This was Cartee's first semester ever being a professor and he did so good! He's very chill and doesn't try to overcomplicate the classes like many other profs do. Homeworks were assigned inconsistently but I bet he will be better about that next semester. Tests were also similar to the provided practice versions - they were not bad at all.

Pretty good professor. Lectures felt organized and easy to digest. He posts lecture notes as well, but they're hard to understand on their own. My only gripe with the course was homework keys being posted very late (up until right before the corresponding exam). Otherwise, he made the course easy to understand and is very lenient w/ partial credit.

This class can be very challenging with a bad professor but Dr. Cartee made it very easy and understandable. The lecture notes require you to come to class to truly understand the, but he is a great lecturer and explains things very well. If you do not understand something go to his office hours. Great professor and generous grader.

Overall good professor. Only criticisms is that he writes in cursive and doesn't have note outlines, but solid otherwise. Reasonable exams that reflect practice. Inconsistent when assigning weekly homework (we had less homework compare to other profs which can be a plus to some) Nice prof, but Diffeq is very test heavy so don't slack off.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Explains everything very clearly. Exams are very similar to practice exams. Only problems are the lecture notes can sometimes be hard to read as they're in cursive and homeworks are sometimes assigned just days before they're due. There's often an announcement but sometimes they're isn't
Everything on exams is covered in class and on homework. Lecture notes are posted on Canvas. Made the material simple to understand. Super chill.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Elliot is the man

Extremely clear lectures, clean/perfect notes and pacing. Difficulty not bad and content is straightforward, tests similar to reviews, reasonable workload. Homeworks are not tough all same workload but inconsistent scheduling, one was given 2 weeks to work on and one was given 3 days. Syllabus says weekly HW and some weeks we did not have HW.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked how he lectured, I thought he was very clear in comparison to some of the past Math department professors I have had. He makes his exam reviews very similar to his exams so studying those are very helpful. The only critique I would have regarding his class would be that he assigns homework's too close to the due date.
